title: Make SMB microbolus threshold configurable
body: I noticed values <= 0.3u are display as SMB. SMB sometimes delivers 0.4u/0.5u microboluses for me. I could not find an option to configure the threshold (#562 referenced an option somewhere that I am unable to find).

comments.body:
@nshtg What is the status of this?
What exactly do you mean by values <= 0.3u?  Can you provide an example?

I don't use xdrip to display bolus / carbs anymore, only bg.

The problem back then was:

- bolus 0.2u manually
- xdrip thinks this is a SMB and displays it accordingly
- xdrip does not differentate between loop SMB and manual boluses that are very small

So, it is possible this problem does not exist any longer.
I suggest we close this issue.
If the problem still exists, and someone reports it, we can reopen this issue.

I can help. In xdrip, each Bolus <=0.3 units is shown as a triangle (if the corresponding) option ist activated. But each bolus >0.3 units is displayed with its value (doesn't matter if it's smb or not).
It would be great to have an option to display all smb, regardless of size, as triangles. As an alternative, the threshold of 0.3 units, which decides if there ist an triangle or not, could be changed by the user as an option.

This issue still seem to persist. Any resolution in the pipeline for it?

Each insulin treatment shows a symbol as well as a value on screen.  
This caused cluttering the screen.
A decluttering element was added to xDrip that for insulin treatments less than or equal to 0.3 units, the value is not shown.  The symbol is also different.  It is a triangle.

You can disable this decluttering feature.  To do that, disable the following:
Settings > Display settings > Graph settings > Show micro bolus icons  

Enabled (default): Showing insulin treatments less than 0.3 units with a triangle.
Disabled: Show all insulin treatments the same way regardless of value.  

I am going to close this issue because I think the intent was misunderstood.
However, if anyone has any comments/suggestions/questions, please post here and if needed, we can reopen.
